reviewMethod: All 254 cached source records and images reviewed against Zeno breadcrumb/category structure; explicit source text used for catalogue/ruler crosswalks. Zeno category membership is retained as source grouping, not treated by itself as a definitive academic variant.

familyCrosswalk.basis: Existing sr6 is the Turgesh qaghan/tamgha family; #795 branch 14906 shares the Sogdian Turgesh-qaghan legend. Leaf categories are kept as separate source groups, so Kamyshev 24 is not projected onto every specimen.
Existing sr3 is Vahshutava/Kamyshev 21 (Yuan). Zeno branch 20165 contains Vahshutava with Yuan and prn subgroups; family is broadened to Vahshutava series while source groups remain distinct.
Explicit source branch/ruler legend Alp Tagh; no existing family corresponds.
Explicit Arslan Kul Irkin source branch with Kamyshev 45 examples; no existing family corresponds.
Existing sr9 is Kamyshev 33 / legacy Inal-Tegin. Zeno files the same catalogue complex as Arslan Irkin (ex. Inal Tegin). The legacy ID remains stable and the attribution conflict is preserved.
Arslan Bilge Qaghan branch corresponds to existing sr20 family; source groups preserve normal/inverted legend and catalogue-number differences.

sameSpecimenMerges.basis: Zeno description states image published with permission from COINS OF CENTRAL ASIA; visual comparison is the same coin/photo as existing sr9.

doNotMerge.basis: Images reuse the same obverse photograph but show different reverse photographs; this is an image/source anomaly, not evidence for one physical specimen.

identityReview.methodNote: Exact source-image SHA-256 duplicates: none. Duplicate external auction/listing identifiers: none. Near-image screening was used only to surface candidates; no merge is made from visual similarity alone.
